posts.title: Bike ride
posts.description: Yesterday was Saturday We went to the Big Market in neighbouring Cattolica - we walked by way of the cash machine and along the port. The market was huge. Lots of stalls selling cheap women's clothes (including €1 dresses if you had the patience to sort through the dross), and a few stalls with menswear. posts.title: Italy - We are in you
posts.description: It was 2:45 in the morning when we were collected by the driver from Saga. I'd forgotten that such times existed in the real world. We were driven - along with a couple from Nottingham - quite painlessly to Heathrow Terminal 5, arriving at the ungodly hour of 4:30 or thereabouts.
